name: Task_6
description:
Equilibrate bulk Aluminum at 300 K for a vibrational density-of-states calculation. Start with a primitive face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Aluminum (a = 4.05 \u00c5) and replicate it into a 4 \u00d7 4 \u00d7 4 supercell. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the ASE-compatible calculator. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble at 300 K with a timestep 1 fs, equilibrating for at least 2 ps and until the terminal half is settled near 300 K.

Keep the 64-atom cell fixed, initialize Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities once at 300 K with a recorded seed, and remove center-of-mass momentum once without subsequent velocity resets or rescaling. Retain at least 32 equilibration samples spaced at most 100 fs apart. The evaluator derives the mean temperature of their final half. Retain the calculation and a restartable final state with your own code.
